name: All Convert
tagline: One powerful workspace for your everyday file conversions.
description: All Convert is being developed as a versatile mobile file-conversion workspace. The goal is to make common document, image and file tasks feel simple: choose a file, convert it, review the result and save or share it from one focused workflow. AVIF support is part of the planned format experience.
audience: For students, professionals, creators and anyone who regularly works with files on a phone.
features: Convert supported documents and images from one mobile workspace
Choose files from your device with a focused file-picker workflow
Save, share or open supported output files
AVIF image support is planned to remain available
A clean workflow designed for phone screens
useCases: Convert images for websites or messages
Keep common file tasks together on your phone

name: QR Scanner
tagline: A fast, focused way to scan QR codes and barcodes.
description: QR Scanner is being developed to make everyday scanning straightforward. Open the scanner, point your camera at a code and review the result in a clean interface. The planned experience also includes gallery-based scanning when camera access is unavailable, plus useful scan history and controls.
audience: For shoppers, travellers, small businesses and everyday users who need to read QR codes and barcodes.
features: Scan QR codes and supported barcode formats
A focused scan frame without an oversized camera preview
Gallery scanning fallback for supported images
Review scan results before opening links
Scan history for convenient access to previous results
Sound, vibration and automatic-link settings planned
useCases: Open website and product QR codes
Read barcodes while shopping or managing stock
Scan a saved code image from your gallery
